title: Fence Material Reservations: Connect NetSuite Stock With a Supabase Fabrication and Installation Board
summary: Show fence-material commitments by job without treating a shared planning board as an inventory reservation engine.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A fencing fabrication and installation board should distinguish material on hand, material committed to a job, cut or fabricated work, and staged installation stock. NetSuite–Supabase two-way sync can share approved inventory and job context while the app collects requests and progress evidence. Actual reservations and transfers require verified inventory actions and ownership rules. A coordinator changing a board column should not automatically consume stock or guarantee material that another job already holds.


Explore the complete[fencing fabrication and installation integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/fencing-fabrication-installation) for the systems and processes around this guide.
